glide.zh: 人们普遍认为悬挂式滑翔运动是危险的。

harass.zh: 市長一家人一整天不斷遭到了恐嚇電話的騷擾。

thermal.zh: 原子反应堆发出大量的热能。

arouse.en: Coffee does not arouse my interest.
arouse.zh: 咖啡不能引起我的兴趣。

consolidate.zh: 真正的王在巩固他的权利，然而虚假的王却在打高尔夫。

affluent.zh: 由于科学技术的进步，人类现在很富裕。

lurk.en: What is lurking in the shadows?

lurk.zh: 要解开谋杀背后潜藏之谜！

constellation.en: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
constellation.zh: 我數著星宿的星光來預測我愛情的未來。

fusion.zh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的融合。

orchard.en: They stole apples from my orchard.
orchard.zh: 他們從我的果園偷了蘋果。

orchard.zh: 我樂意每年秋季去蘋果園。

chord.zh: 钢琴是和弦乐器，笛子是单音乐器。

restless.zh: 你度过了很不安宁的一夜。

giggle.zh: 她害羞地笑着拿出了避孕套。

ignorant.zh: 我对这个计划一无所知。

amend.zh: 我是个有缺点的人，但这些缺点很容易就能被改正。

razor.en: The razor made a buzzing sound.

sewer.en: The sewer ran under the road.

fertile.en: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.
fertile.zh: 這是一片肥沃的土地，居住著不同的民族。

prose.zh: 他不是诗人；他是个散文作家。

capsule.zh: 那个建筑物是男女都可以住宿的胶囊酒店。

anonymity.zh: 不留名或详细的参考什么都可以。

pragmatic.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
pragmatic.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

mock.zh: 未来飞行员将在模拟操作室中训练。

fig.zh: 阿图什的无花果是甜蜜多汁的。

arbitrary.zh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

novice.zh: 當說到愛情，女人是專家而男人永遠是新手。

ranger.en: I used to be a forest ranger.

wade.zh: 我們一步一步地踏進了冰冷的水裏。

perpetuate.en: Lonely people perpetuate their own loneliness through their fear of others.
perpetuate.zh: 孤獨的人會孤獨，是因為他畏懼他人。

brink.zh: 在人類自我毀滅的邊緣，第一次接觸成了福音。

symphony.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

recede.zh: 她開始在我的記憶中消散。

literal.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。

pinpoint.zh: 無論你在世界的哪一個角落，你都可以使用全球定位儀來找出你的所在。

alibi.zh: 湯姆沒有無懈可擊的不在場證明。

lull.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.
The sound of crickets chirping and frogs croaking lulls me to sleep.
lull.zh: 蟋蟀的叫声与蛙鸣催我入眠。

stout.en: Irish stout is the best beer.
stout.zh: 啤酒以爱尔兰黑啤酒为最佳。

aggressor.en: The aggressors are bound to be defeated.

spatula.en: Are spatulas for scraping or turning?
spatula.zh: 鏟子是用來刮削還是翻菜的？

pretext.en: Jonas left under the pretext of going to the bathroom.
pretext.zh: 喬納斯以去洗手間為藉口離開了。

pretext.en: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
pretext.zh: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。

ruffle.zh: 蕾拉穿着带褶子的短袜。

acronym.en: Who can tell me what the acronym Tatoeba stands for?
acronym.zh: 谁能告诉我TATOEBA首字母缩合词的意思？

vile.en: Guards! Slap that vile woman's face!
vile.zh: 來人，給我掌這賤女人嘴巴！

malice.en: There was no malice intended in what she said.
Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
malice.zh: 能解釋為愚蠢的，就不要解釋為惡意。

deforestation.en: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
deforestation.zh: 棕榈油制造是导致印度尼西亚森林砍伐的主要原因。

crevice.en: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
crevice.zh: 海底的岩石缝里藏着一只章鱼。

nag.en: I don't mean to nag you.
Mike is always nagging his father to buy him a car.
nag.zh: 米克整天都在求爸爸買車給他。

freckle.en: Red-haired people tend to have freckles.

austere.en: Ms. Eichler had a notorious reputation for being austere to her students.
austere.zh: 艾希勒女士对学生严厉是出了名的。

abstain.en: My father tries to abstain from drinking.

exclamation.en: An exclamation mark is a punctuation mark.

reactionary.en: A conservative is not always a reactionary.
reactionary.zh: 保守分子不一定是反动分子。

reactionary.en: Reactionary groups were overthrown by the people.

disband.en: The President cannot disband the Parliament.

impeach.en: You guys in America can impeach your president too.
impeach.zh: 你們美國人也可以彈劾你們的總統。

retract.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
retract.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

nip.en: Nip over there and ask. Hurry!
nip.zh: 快赶到那边去打听，快走！

obligatory.en: Is it obligatory to rent a car?

falcon.en: Shahina is an Arabic name meaning "falcon".
falcon.zh: Shahina是阿拉伯名，意思是猎鹰。

hypocritical.en: I've never known anyone as hypocritical as you.
hypocritical.zh: 我从来没有见过谁像你这么虚伪的。

buoy.en: The yacht sailed around a buoy.

calibrate.en: This instrument needs to be calibrated.

flask.en: He took a swig from his flask.
flask.zh: 他从酒壶里喝了一大口。

flask.en: Obviously, we don't know if those thermos flasks are their own.
flask.zh: 当然，那些热水瓶是不是他们自己的就不得而知了。

bibliography.en: Hand in a bibliography of your sources.

scorch.en: In the scorching heat, the cat is spread out lethargically on the ground.
scorch.zh: 在炎热的天气里，猫咪没精神地摊在地上。

ambience.en: A small European shop opened inside. The ambience is great!
ambience.zh: 里面开了一个个欧式的小店，情调好极了！

aristocrat.en: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
aristocrat.zh: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。

hoarse.en: They were all hoarse from shouting.

slither.en: The slippery snake slithered right out of his hand.
slither.zh: 那條蛇滑溜溜的，一下子就從他的手中掉了出來。

prank.en: So don't use this for pranking, right?

chirp.en: Tom could hear birds chirping outside his window.
chirp.zh: 湯姆能聽到窗外的鳥鳴聲。

chirp.en: The sound of crickets chirping and frogs croaking lulls me to sleep.
chirp.zh: 蟋蟀的叫声与蛙鸣催我入眠。

prune.en: Tell her that I am pruning the trees.
Ziri showed Rima how to properly prune her palm trees.
prune.zh: 齊里向里瑪示範如何正確修剪棕櫚樹。

pandemic.en: It's all due to the pandemic.

prodigy.en: Mozart: one of the great musical prodigies of all time.
prodigy.zh: 莫札特: 一個永遠的音樂奇才

irritable.en: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
irritable.zh: 他早上总是有点脾气暴躁。

irritable.en: Irritable men are always the last to know about things.
irritable.zh: 脾氣不好的人總是最晚獲知任何訊息。

exposition.en: The exposition will be held for six months.

nimble.en: Poor cat! She can't catch the nimble mouse.
nimble.zh: 可怜的猫！ 她无法抓住敏捷的老鼠。

spank.en: When I was a child, I was spanked if I did something wrong.
spank.zh: 我小時候做錯事就會被打屁股。

rickety.en: The newborn giraffe stumbled around on rickety legs.
rickety.zh: 新生的長頸鹿搖晃著腿跌跌撞撞地走。

husk.en: I am going to husk rice.

peck.en: He gave her a peck on the cheek.
peck.zh: 他在她的臉上輕輕的親了一下。

peck.en: Anglo-Saxon was to Norman as hen-pecked to uxorious.
peck.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人对诺曼人来说就像妻管严对溺爱妻子的人一样。

obedient.en: He was a great teacher so his children were very obedient.
obedient.zh: 他很会教育人，所以他的孩子都很听话。

hospitable.en: The Algerians are a hospitable people.
hospitable.zh: 阿爾及利亞人是好客的族群。

virulent.en: Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
virulent.zh: 埃博拉是人类已知的最致命的病毒之一。

reek.en: When he came and found me, his whole body reeked of alcohol.
reek.zh: 他来找我的时候全身都是酒的味道。

forsake.en: He could not forsake his friend in trouble.
forsake.zh: 他不会抛下落难的朋友不管。

consummate.zh: 汤姆是一位完美的专业人士。

nomad.zh: 我一辈子都是个流浪者。

skunk.en: I almost stepped on a skunk last night.
skunk.zh: 我昨晚差点踩到一只臭鼬。

tenacity.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

maroon.en: They were marooned on a desert isle.
maroon.zh: 她们被抛弃在一座荒岛上。

vogue.en: His novel had a great vogue for a long time.
vogue.zh: 他的小說風行了一段長時間。

vogue.en: It's kind of in vogue, but the price is too much!
vogue.zh: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！

rowdy.en: Tom always gets rowdy when he drinks tequila.
rowdy.zh: 湯姆一喝龍舌蘭酒就變得很吵。

embankment.en: Blossoms have come out on the embankment.

archer.en: He assigned two archers to me.
archer.zh: 他派給我了兩名弓箭手。

bleach.en: Don't mix ammonia and bleach together.
bleach.zh: 别把氨水和漂白剂混在一起。

bleach.en: A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
bleach.zh: 桌上擺放著一瓶被霜凍漂白的蕨類植物和紅寶石色的楓葉。

hoard.en: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.
hoard.zh: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。

diligence.en: Her diligence is a good example to us all.
diligence.zh: 她的用功对我们所有人是一个好的榜样。

ripen.en: Their friendship ripened into a deep love.
ripen.zh: 他们的友情酝酿成了爱情。

discord.en: He sows discord by raising controversial subjects.
discord.zh: 他挑起爭議性高的話題，製造紛爭。

discord.en: Finally, the discord between them came to an end.
discord.zh: 他們的衝突終於平息了。

malfunction.en: This clock seems to be malfunctioning.
The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
malfunction.zh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。

infraction.en: He was excluded from the club for infractions of the rules.
infraction.zh: 他觸犯會規，被踢出了俱樂部。

qualm.en: He had no qualms in doing so.
qualm.zh: 他这么做，没有任何不安。

reprimand.en: He reprimanded me for my oversight.
The teacher severely reprimanded his pupils.
reprimand.zh: 老師把學生狠狠地罵了一頓。

sterilize.en: Yanni has just sterilized his milking bucket.
sterilize.zh: 雅尼剛剛對他的擠奶桶進行了消毒。

besiege.en: The author of Fortress Besieged is Qian Zhongshu.

violet.en: This flower is violet in color.

bode.en: His laziness boded ill for the future.
bode.zh: 他的懒惰是他未来不好的预兆。

nectar.en: Hummingbirds drink the sweet nectar from certain flowers.
nectar.zh: 蜂鳥會吸食某些花朵的甜美花蜜。

enumerate.en: They are too numerous to enumerate.
enumerate.zh: 他们人太多了，数不过来。

refurbish.en: I might consider buying a refurbished phone.
refurbish.zh: 我可能也會購買整修品。

blight.en: The governor's recent scandal was a blight on her otherwise pristine track record.
blight.zh: 州長最近的醜聞玷污了她原本完美無瑕的政績。

elated.en: He became very elated at the news.
elated.zh: 他听到这个消息非常喜欢。

compliant.en: According to custom, the bride should be compliant.
compliant.zh: 根据习俗，新娘应该循规蹈矩。

tantamount.en: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
tantamount.zh: 靠武力取勝，猶如落敗，因為這樣的勝利不會長久。

droop.en: The heads of the flowers in the garden were drooping.
droop.zh: 花園中一片花枝累垂的樣子。

avenge.en: He avenged the murder of his father.
avenge.zh: 他对杀父凶手进行了报复。

spurn.en: So-called regional specialities are things prized by out-of-towners but spurned by locals.
spurn.zh: 所谓特产，就是外地人奉之为宝，本地人嗤之以鼻的东西。

lyric.en: I like lyric better than epic.
lyric.zh: 我喜歡抒情詩多於史詩。

lyric.en: I found the lyrics, but I can't copy-paste them.
lyric.zh: 我找到了歌词，但是没法转贴过来。

locust.en: That's not a grasshopper. It's a locust!

tongs.en: Unable to find a spatula, Tom used tongs to flip the pancakes.
tongs.zh: 湯姆找不到鍋鏟了，只好用夾子為煎餅翻面。

contrive.en: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
contrive.zh: 他用了一些手段来和Nancy私下交谈。

condescending.en: Sami was extremely rude and condescending to Layla.

grisly.en: Police arrived at the grisly crime scene.
grisly.zh: 警察到达了可怕的犯罪现场。

swine.en: Your wonderful lecture was pearls before swine.
swine.zh: 你的演說十分精彩，但竟沒人懂得欣賞。

vaccinate.en: I was vaccinated against the flu.

acorn.zh: 这个菜谱需要一些青南瓜。

acorn.en: A hungry pig dreams of acorns.

phobia.en: Do you have deep sea phobia?

compatriot.en: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.

hoe.en: Be careful when working with a hoe.
hoe.zh: 用锄头的时候小心一些

nymph.en: You scorned both the Nymphs, who beheld your deeds, and me the mighty Pan.
nymph.zh: 你蔑視了目睹你罪行的仙女們，也蔑視了我を這位強大的潘神。

insinuate.en: Fine words and an insinuating appearance are seldom associated with true virtue.

kangaroo.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
kangaroo.zh: 澳大利亚土著已经吃了上千年袋鼠。

fickle.en: A woman is ever fickle and changeable.
I'll eat almost anything, but I'm very fickle when it comes to cheese.
fickle.zh: 我是甚麼都吃的那種人，但是吃起司卻很講心情。

shelve.en: He crowded the books into the shelves.
There aren't many books on these shelves.
shelve.zh: 这些书架上没有很多书。

circumference.en: Is it possible to determine the diameter from the circumference?
circumference.zh: 用圓周能不能求得直徑？

acuity.en: The hearing acuity of dogs is superior by far to that of humans.
acuity.zh: 狗的聽覺比人類靈敏不知多少倍。

bough.en: The boughs that bear most hang lowest.

inconsequential.en: The things he says are entirely inconsequential.
inconsequential.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。

concise.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
concise.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

concise.en: Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
concise.zh: 两者都可以，但是前者更简洁。

kennel.en: Why is the cat in the dog's kennel?

invert.en: Through the lens the image was inverted.

downpour.en: I was utterly soaked by the downpour.

promenade.en: Algiers has a beautiful promenade on the seashore.
promenade.zh: 阿尔及尔有一条美丽的海滨长廊。

recuperate.zh: 不久後, 他恢復了健康。

engross.en: He was completely engrossed in the book.
Takeo is engrossed in solving mathematical problems.
engross.zh: 建夫专心致志地解决数学问题。

rant.en: I just want to rant a little bit.
The man ranted and raved, but her well practiced customer service smile remained unflinching.
rant.zh: 那個男人大聲咆哮，但她訓練有素的客服式微笑始終沒有消退。

snare.en: Yanni panicked like a wolf in a snare.
snare.zh: 雅妮像中了圈套的狼一样惊慌

snare.en: A fox isn't caught twice in the same snare.
snare.zh: 一只狐狸不会两次掉入同一个陷阱里。

bequeath.en: He bequeathed his fortune to his son.
bequeath.zh: 他把财产留给了他的儿子。

bondage.en: He liberated the people from bondage.
I guess she's into bondage and domination.
bondage.zh: 我想她想要的是束縛與支配。

sordid.en: Sami's sordid love affair destroyed his marriage.
sordid.zh: 薩米這段不堪入目的婚外情毀了他的婚姻。

superfluous.en: There was always too much superfluous writing in his essays.
superfluous.zh: 在他的文章中总是有太多肤浅的桥段。

falsify.en: The prediction was falsified by the result.
falsify.zh: 預言被實驗結果推翻了。

detest.en: I detest everyone, and everyone detests me.
detest.zh: 我厌恶每个人，每个人都厌恶我。

mutate.en: The virus is starting to mutate.

goblet.en: This goblet is made of gold.

despicable.en: I am ashamed of your despicable deed.
despicable.zh: 我为你的卑鄙行径感到羞耻。

trifle.zh: 不要把時間浪費在瑣事上

trifle.en: Their trouble stems from a trifling matter.
trifle.zh: 他們的煩惱是由一件瑣碎的事而起的。

amphibian.en: Fish, amphibians, and reptiles are cold-blooded animals.
amphibian.zh: 魚類、兩棲類和爬行類都是冷血動物。

forgery.en: The signature had been a forgery.

evasive.zh: 汤姆的回答很含糊不清。

evasive.en: Why are you being so evasive?
evasive.zh: 你为什么这么含糊其辞？

mitten.en: Vanessa loves to knit hats, scarves, and mittens in rainbow colors.
mitten.zh: Vanessa喜欢针织彩虹色的帽子、围巾和连指手套。

frugal.en: She is used to living a hardworking and frugal life.

voracious.en: After skiing, I find that I have a voracious appetite.
voracious.zh: 滑完雪后，我发现我食欲大增。

remittance.en: I'm sorry, without an I.D. you cannot receive a remittance.
remittance.zh: 对不起，没有身份证是不能领汇款的。

inverse.en: The inverse of a non-square matrix is a dangerous thing.
inverse.zh: 非方矩阵的逆阵是一个危险的东西。

repent.en: He repented having betrayed his country to the enemy.
repent.zh: 他後悔對敵人出賣了他的國家。

croak.en: The sound of crickets chirping and frogs croaking lulls me to sleep.
croak.zh: 蟋蟀的叫声与蛙鸣催我入眠。

brooch.en: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.
brooch.zh: 寶石師傅在胸針上鑲了一枚大珍珠。

brooch.en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.
brooch.zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。

carp.en: Fish such as carp and trout live in fresh water.
carp.zh: 鲤鱼和鳟鱼等鱼类生活在淡水中。

eloquence.en: Eloquence is silver, silence is golden.

ruddy.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, chosen out of thousands.
ruddy.zh: 我所爱的是白皙红润，千里挑一的。

unscrupulous.en: Many public school cafeterias are unscrupulous.
unscrupulous.zh: 很多公立学校的食堂都很黑心。

unscrupulous.en: Do you think Tom is unscrupulous?

astray.en: She went astray in the woods.

monotonous.en: I am tired of my monotonous life.
monotonous.zh: 我厌倦了现在单调的生活。

moat.en: The river outside of the castle is called a moat.
moat.zh: 城堡外面的河叫做護城河。

condiment.en: The fridge is overloaded with condiments.

banter.en: Lucy was bantered by her grandparents.
banter.zh: 露西被她的祖父母揶揄。

harry.en: Sally met Harry at the station.
harry.zh: 莎莉在車站遇見了哈利。

tribulation.en: I've come across all kinds of trials and tribulations.
tribulation.zh: 我遇见过各种各样的困难。

preservative.en: No artificial colours, preservatives or flavours.
preservative.zh: 不含香料、防腐劑及人造色素。

dehydrate.en: The doctor suggested that she drink more water to keep from being dehydrated.
dehydrate.zh: 醫生建議她多喝水，以免缺水。

unicorn.en: The unicorn is a fabulous monster.
unicorn.zh: 獨角獸是一種美麗的怪物。

hemorrhage.en: My father died of a subarachnoid hemorrhage when I was fourteen.
hemorrhage.zh: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。

monopolize.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.
monopolize.zh: 他們壟斷了原物料供應，並開天價。

monopolize.en: At the meeting he monopolized the discussion and completely disrupted the proceeding.
monopolize.zh: 在這次會議上, 他壟斷了討論並徹底打亂了議程。

grumpy.zh: 汤姆脾气为什么总这么坏？

grumpy.en: Tom is a grumpy old man.
grumpy.zh: 汤姆是个脾气暴躁的老人。

enchant.en: The forest in the fall is splendidly colorful, a thoroughly enchanting sight.
enchant.zh: 秋天的森林五彩斑斓，景色十分迷人。

germinate.en: What should one do with germinating garlic bulbs?

wick.en: A candle without a wick is no candle at all.
wick.zh: 蠟燭沒有了芯，就不能算是蠟燭了。

pariah.en: Putin will be a pariah on the international stage.
pariah.zh: 普丁將成為國際舞台上的棄兒。

blemish.en: Her skin was white as milk and she had not a single blemish anywhere.
blemish.zh: 她的肌肤如同牛奶一样洁白，身上没有一处斑点。

blemish.en: Her skin is as white as milk, without a single blemish on her body.
blemish.zh: 她的肌肤如同牛奶一样洁白，身上没有一处斑点。

zigzag.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
zigzag.zh: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

bawl.en: I'm tired of him bawling me out.

foodstuff.en: There is an abundant supply of foodstuffs.

foodstuff.zh: 土豆是最常见的食材之一。

beholder.en: Beauty's in the eye of the beholder.
beholder.zh: 美驻留在看的那个人的眼里。

beholder.en: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

premonition.en: My premonition turned out to be right.
premonition.zh: 我的预感被证明是正确的。

conceit.en: The world tolerates conceit from those who are successful, but not from anybody else.
conceit.zh: 世界只能容忍有成就的人的自傲。

gratify.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
gratify.zh: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

deadlock.zh: 我们必须设法打破这个僵局。

lithe.en: Love me lithe, love me long.
lithe.zh: 淡淡地愛我，長久地愛我。

pliers.en: Put the pliers in the tool box.

libido.en: My wife has no libido since she got pregnant. What can I do?
libido.zh: 老婆怀孕没了性欲我该怎么办？

aurora.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
aurora.zh: 極光是極地特有的自然現象。

artifice.en: The language of truth must be, with no doubt, simple and without artifice.
artifice.zh: 真理的語言必定是樸實無華、毫無矯飾的。

abut.en: My land abuts on the river.

reproach.zh: 他責備了我的粗心大意。

facsimile.en: Could you send me a map by facsimile?
facsimile.zh: 您能把地图传真给我吗？

idolize.en: Is it normal that many young people these days idolize pretty boy stars?
idolize.zh: 現在很多年輕人追捧小鮮肉的現象正常嗎？

foolproof.en: Nothing is foolproof to a talented fool.
foolproof.zh: 对天才的傻瓜来说没有什么不可出乱的。

curt.en: Don't you think it's rude to give people such a curt reply like that?
curt.zh: 你回答得這麼簡短，不覺得有點沒禮貌嗎？

rejuvenate.en: Between friends, to have a heart-to-heart is really rejuvenating.
rejuvenate.zh: 朋友之间，大家谈谈心，非常爽快。

disfigure.en: Dan was disfigured following a car accident.
disfigure.zh: 丹在一场车祸后毁容了。

stingy.en: He is very stingy with his money.

parse.en: How do you parse this sentence?
Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
parse.zh: 不遵守命名规则会导致解析错误。

amulet.en: Tom thought the amulet would protect him from harm.
amulet.zh: 湯姆以為護身符能保護他免受傷害。

intermission.en: From graduation to retirement, Laowang worked as a teacher without intermission.
intermission.zh: 從大學畢業到退休，老王一直擔任教學工作。

porridge.en: There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.
porridge.zh: 俗話說：高麗菜湯和粥是我們的食物。

porridge.en: The only way I can eat porridge is with lots of sugar.
porridge.zh: 唯有加很多糖才能讓我喝得下粥。

industrious.en: The Japanese are an industrious people.
An industrious person will succeed in life.
industrious.zh: 勤劳的人将在生活中获得成功。

repute.en: He is reputed the best lawyer in this city.
repute.zh: 他被认为是这座城市里最好的律师。

comma.en: I'm only going to write small sentences without commas.
comma.zh: 我只是想写一些没有逗号的小句子。

dexterity.en: Playing the piano requires manual dexterity.

opiate.en: Religion is the opiate of the masses.

blasphemy.zh: 亵渎是没有受害者的犯罪。

blasphemy.en: Me? Encourage you to work? Blasphemy!
blasphemy.zh: 我？鼓励你去工作？不可能！

quench.en: Do you have a drink to help quench my thirst?
quench.zh: 你有没有什么喝的给我解渴吗？

calligraphy.en: I know a bit about calligraphy.

comprehensible.en: Legal terminology is not comprehensible to most laypeople.
comprehensible.zh: 法律術語是大多數普通人無法理解的。

acrobat.en: Of course, an acrobat must have a perfect sense of balance.
acrobat.zh: 当然，杂技演员必须有完美的平衡感。

anesthetic.en: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.
anesthetic.zh: 他在麻醉剂的作用下，他失去了知觉。

canary.en: My canary was killed by a cat.
canary.zh: 我的金絲雀被一隻貓殺死了。

faze.en: You're not even fazed. You must have known all along!
faze.zh: 看你并不感到惊讶，你肯定已经知道了。

alphabetical.en: The list was in alphabetical order.
Could you rearrange this list so it's in alphabetical order?
alphabetical.zh: 你能把這清單按字母順序排列嗎？

ponderous.en: The old professor's lectures are long-winded and ponderous.
ponderous.zh: 这位老教授的讲座冗长而沉闷。

jest.en: Many a true word is spoken in jest.

hodgepodge.en: You can put anything into a hodgepodge.
hodgepodge.zh: 什么都可以放在一锅杂烩里。

ewe.en: Ziri is trying to train his ewe to do that.
ewe.zh: 齊里正在訓練他的母羊做這個動作。

inhumane.zh: 這個規定太不人性化了。

scald.en: Tom scalded himself with boiling water.

atrophy.en: The muscles in his legs had atrophied during the seven months he was bedridden.
atrophy.zh: 他的腿部肌肉在他卧床不起的七个月中萎缩了。

rankle.en: His bitter words still rankle in my mind.
rankle.zh: 他尖刻的话语仍然在我心中挥之不去。

lustrous.en: The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.
lustrous.zh: 王冠上鑲嵌著數十顆光彩奪目的寶石。

stupor.en: The patient is in a state of profound stupor.
stupor.zh: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。

disagreeable.zh: 他是個很討人煩的男人。

disagreeable.en: What a disagreeable fellow he is!
disagreeable.zh: 他可真是個讓人討厭的傢伙！

drudgery.en: With all its sham, drudgery and broken dreams; it is still a beautiful world.
drudgery.zh: 虽然虚伪、苦痛还有破碎的梦伴随着我，但这仍然是一个美丽的世界。

exult.en: The people exulted over their good luck.
exult.zh: 人們都為他們的好運感到十分高興。

thatch.en: The tall house was covered with a thatched roof.
thatch.zh: 這棟很高的房子被茅草屋頂覆蓋著。

culpable.en: According to what she said, he's culpable.
culpable.zh: 根據她所說的, 他是有罪的。

mauve.zh: 石楠花通常是淡紫色的。

sociable.en: I attended the party just to be sociable.
sociable.zh: 我去那個派對純粹是為了交際。

encyclopedic.en: She has an encyclopedic knowledge of cooking.
encyclopedic.zh: 她是一部活生生的廚藝百科全書。

begrudge.en: Our boss begrudged us even a small raise in pay.
begrudge.zh: 我们的老板就连给我们涨一点工资都舍不得。

capsize.en: The ship keeled over and capsized.
capsize.zh: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了過來。

averse.en: Some of my friends are strongly averse to AI.

cleaver.en: I'm going to chop her head off with a cleaver.
cleaver.zh: 我要用剁骨刀把她的脑袋剁掉。

sonata.en: I'll play a sonata for you.
sonata.zh: 我要为你演奏一首奏鸣曲。

perishable.en: During hot season, perishables go bad easily.
perishable.zh: 在炎熱的季節時，有些食品很容易變壞。

hydrate.en: I hear that keeping yourself hydrated at appropriate times can help prevent heatstroke.
hydrate.zh: 听说适时地补充水分可以预防中暑。

leniency.zh: 我可以指望從寬處理嗎？

wrangle.en: The two scholars wrangled over the meaning of an obscure Tibetan phrase.
wrangle.zh: 兩位學者為一句意思含糊的藏文句子爭論了一番。

pliable.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
pliable.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

mutilate.en: Mutilating intersex babies is something almost every transphobe supports.
mutilate.zh: 殘害陰陽人嬰兒幾乎是每個恐跨者都支持的事情。

teem.en: The forest is teeming with monkeys.

torrential.en: The hillside had torrential flooding from the west.
torrential.zh: 山坡让滔滔的洪水往西流。

astrology.en: What's the difference between astronomy and astrology?
She told him that she believed in astrology.
astrology.zh: 她告诉了他自己相信占星术。

raffle.en: Have you bought a raffle ticket yet?

thrifty.en: He is thrifty, not to say stingy.
thrifty.zh: 他勤俭节约，甚至是小气的。

moldy.en: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
moldy.zh: 台子上有个发霉的面包。

oxidize.en: As it oxidizes, the color turns blue and finally becomes a brilliant reddish-purple hue.
oxidize.zh: 隨氧化變成藍色，最終呈現出鮮豔的紅紫色。

phoenix.en: Phoenix is the capital of Arizona.
phoenix.zh: 鳳凰城是亞利桑那州的首府。

muggy.en: It is less muggy today than it was yesterday.

brook.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

swindle.en: Be careful. He's not an easy one to swindle.

tempest.en: Mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are a tempest and hailstorm.
tempest.zh: 婆婆和媳婦就像是暴風雨和冰雹。

cutlery.en: This restaurant is particular about cutlery.
cutlery.zh: 这家饭馆的餐具很讲究

gladiator.zh: 角鬥士在羅馬競技場中搏鬥。

deactivate.en: I deactivated my Twitter account yesterday.
deactivate.zh: 我昨天停用了推特账户。

deactivate.en: How can I deactivate my account on this site?
deactivate.zh: 我要怎麼停用我在這個網站上的帳戶？

hedgehog.en: She says that she's never seen hedgehogs with ears.
hedgehog.zh: 她说她从未见过有耳朵的刺猬。

abbreviate.en: Science-Fiction can be abbreviated as sci-fi.
abbreviate.zh: 科學幻想的簡稱是科幻。

abhorrent.en: Such an idea is abhorrent to her.

nepotism.en: Nepotism is quite common in China.
nepotism.zh: 裙带关系在中国很普遍。

comport.en: When one is in difficulty and comports themselves well, that is a master.

convex.en: If human life is convex, we can optimize it.
convex.zh: 如果人生是凸的，那我们可以优化它。

stickler.en: He is a stickler for principles.

vagabond.en: The vagabond, when rich, is called a tourist.
vagabond.zh: 當流浪漢有錢了, 就被稱為遊客。

gild.en: While the rest of us work hard, the robber barons eat with gilded utensils.
gild.zh: 當我們其他人辛苦工作時，強盜貴族卻用鍍金餐具吃飯。

pollinate.en: Figs are pollinated by fig wasps.

tambourine.en: I gave my dad a tambourine as a gift.
tambourine.zh: 我给我的老爸送了一个铃鼓。

premeditated.zh: 这是一个有预谋的犯罪。

guile.en: I refuse to be taken in by her guile.
guile.zh: 我是不會被她的詭計騙倒的。

underrate.en: The importance of music is underrated.
underrate.zh: 音乐的重要性被低估了。

cartographer.en: This cartographer is famous for the precision in his maps.
cartographer.zh: 此製圖員出名於其製圖的精準性。

cartographer.en: This cartographer is famous for the precision in her maps.
cartographer.zh: 此製圖員出名於其製圖的精準性。

diaphanous.en: I am completely agog over your diaphanous dress.
diaphanous.zh: 你半透明的裙子让我高度兴奋。

feckless.en: Our feckless opposition party didn't do enough to stop him.
feckless.zh: 我们软弱的反对派不足以阻止他。

chaff.en: That person's so stingy that he won't even let the mouse have the chaff.
chaff.zh: 那个人那么小气，连谷壳都不让老鼠吃。

ford.en: Mr Ford is all right now.
I forgot to call up Mr Ford.
ford.zh: 我忘了给福特先生打电话。

barrister.en: She practised as a barrister for many years.

enamored.en: He was enamored of the girl.

daub.en: I daub the venison with shortening.
daub.zh: 我把起酥油塗抹在鹿肉上。

inviolable.en: My room is an inviolable refuge.
inviolable.zh: 我的房間是不可侵犯的避難所。

inviolable.en: The guards are sacred and inviolable.

plait.en: She wore her hair in plaits.
Mary plaits her hair into a pigtail.
plait.zh: 瑪莉把頭髮編成雙馬尾。

miser.en: The miser opened the box to find his money stolen.
miser.zh: 這個守財奴打開了盒子，發現他的錢被偷了。

truant.en: Quite a few students played truant from school.

fallacious.en: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
fallacious.zh: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

polyglot.en: It doesn't require you to be a polyglot.

impudent.en: The old man assumed an impudent attitude.
impudent.zh: 老人採取了傲慢的態度。

impudent.en: We mustn't give way to these impudent demands.
impudent.zh: 我們絕不會接受這些橫蠻無理的要求。

besmirch.en: Please don't do anything that would besmirch the Matsuno family name!
besmirch.zh: 请不要做任何有损松野家族名声的事！

flatulence.en: Some legumes, like chickpeas and green beans, cause flatulence but are excellent foods.
flatulence.zh: 鷹嘴豆和青豆等豆類雖然會引起脹氣，但卻是極佳的美食。

carol.zh: 卡羅正在學習西班牙語。

defeatist.en: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
defeatist.zh: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。

swill.en: Swill the teapot out with water.
swill.zh: 茶壶里再冲点水在里面。

hexagon.en: A hexagon has six angles and six sides.
hexagon.zh: 六邊形有六個角、六條邊。

actuate.en: This device is actuated by a switch.
actuate.zh: 這個裝置是用開關啟動的。

miscellany.en: Only if you put up a different sign can you become a miscellany store.
miscellany.zh: 只要換上不同招牌，就能成為各種商店。

dally.en: Time's almost up, why are you still dilly-dallying?
dally.zh: 时间快要到了，你怎么还拖啊拖的。

reprove.en: The principal severely reproved the students whenever they made a mess in the hallway.
reprove.zh: 每次学生把走廊弄得一团糟的时候，校长都会严厉地训斥他们。

agog.en: I am completely agog over your diaphanous dress.
agog.zh: 你半透明的裙子让我高度兴奋。

repugnance.en: I cannot overcome my repugnance to eating snails.
repugnance.zh: 吃蜗牛真恶心, 我可受不了.

adulterate.en: You should not adulterate wine with water.
adulterate.zh: 你不應該把水混入葡萄酒裡。

ruminant.en: Ruminants are a group of mammals.
ruminant.zh: 牛是一种反刍类的哺乳动物。

euphonious.en: In the evening quiet, we enjoy the song of the euphonious nightingale.
euphonious.zh: 在安静的晚上，我们沉浸在夜莺悦耳的歌声中。

equable.en: It's lucky that his parents are so equable.
equable.zh: 值得庆幸的是他双亲性情非常温和。

desuetude.en: That tradition has fallen into desuetude.
desuetude.zh: 那習俗已經不再盛行了。

calorie.en: High calorie foods are bad for my health.
calorie.zh: 高卡路里的食物對我的身體不好。

miff.en: I hope you're not too miffed.
I hope that you're not too miffed.

taciturn.zh: 林肯本人是沉默寡言的。

bereave.en: The accident bereaved her of her husband.

congest.zh: 阿爾及爾的街道越來越堵塞了。

festal.en: Each age has deemed the new-born year the fittest time for festal cheer.
festal.zh: 岁岁皆为新生之年，都值得好好庆祝。

invigilate.en: We went to a secondary school to invigilate today.
invigilate.zh: 我们今天去一所中学监考了。

phenomena.en: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.
phenomena.zh: 彩虹是自然界最美的现象之一。

phenomena.en: Three out of four Americans believe in the existence of paranormal phenomena.
phenomena.zh: 四分之三的美国人相信存在超自然现象。

uxorious.en: Anglo-Saxon was to Norman as hen-pecked to uxorious.
uxorious.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人对诺曼人来说就像妻管严对溺爱妻子的人一样。
